# Ultimate 3D Studio

Source repository for the Home Assistant Studio and the separate Compose slicer.

## Start here

- [Studio overview](studio/README.md)
- [Architecture](studio/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Slicer server](studio/Slicer-Server/README.md)
- [Installation](studio/Slicer-Server/INSTALLATION.md)
- [Operation and recovery](studio/Slicer-Server/OPERATIONS.md)
- [Wiki source pages](studio/Slicer-Server/wiki/Home.md)
- [Source notices](SOURCE_NOTICES.md)
- [File-specific notice map](source-license-map.json)

## Delivery status

This is a source delivery candidate. The source quality gate has passed; the
complete isolated delivery candidate still has missing native service sources.
Production deployment, fresh installation and restore acceptance remain open.
The manual Linux testserver follows the complete GitHub source delivery.

The slicer runs separately from Home Assistant. Compose is the intended clean
installation path. Existing native installations must not be adopted, removed
or migrated automatically. Engine catalog entries remain pending.

## Licensing

The inherited [MIT notice](LICENSE) remains available. New original material
in the Slicer-Server area has separate [private-use terms](studio/Slicer-Server/LICENSE).
Previously licensed and third-party material retains its own applicable terms.
The selected upstream profile originals, derived defaults and source notices
are identified separately; they are not relabeled as privately licensed code.

See [SOURCE_NOTICES.md](SOURCE_NOTICES.md) for the concrete file boundaries.

# Source distribution notices

This document describes notices for the proposed source-only repository
delivery. It does not approve a production image, engine executable, plugin,
fresh installation or public release.

## Inherited Studio material

Keep the complete [MIT copyright and permission notice](LICENSE) with the
inherited Studio sources and their copies. The exact inherited text is also
preserved in [MIT-Studio.txt](studio/Slicer-Server/licenses/MIT-Studio.txt).
A later folder label does not withdraw permissions previously granted.

## New Slicer-Server material

[The custom license](studio/Slicer-Server/LICENSE) declares its scope as new
original material authored for this project. It excludes imported/generated
payloads, third-party material and material previously licensed differently.
Configuration and user-created data retain the exceptions stated there.

The file map identifies this declared scope. Project timelines and matching
hashes support provenance; they do not certify sole authorship or clear every
possible third-party claim.

## Selected Bambu Studio profile material

Source repository: bambulab/BambuStudio, revision
42d319c6692fa8e64790fddf0cdaafd2a4254bcc.

The unchanged [upstream AGPL text](studio/Slicer-Server/licenses/AGPL-BambuStudio.txt)
is supplied separately. Preserve upstream licensing and attribution for the
118 original profile/include JSON texts in
[PROFILE_SOURCE_BUNDLE.json](studio/Slicer-Server/PROFILE_SOURCE_BUNDLE.json).

The following local data files have documented derivation from those profiles:

- studio/deploy/homeassistant/custom_components/ultimate_3d_studio/native_filament_defaults.json
- studio/deploy/homeassistant/custom_components/ultimate_3d_studio/h2s_native_defaults.json

Their source records and transformations are described in
[PAYLOAD_PROVENANCE.json](studio/Slicer-Server/PAYLOAD_PROVENANCE.json).
The evidence covers 54 selected profiles, 12 process-field projections and
eight sound/template reconstructions. The original JSON source is included;
no engine executable is contained in this source selection.

The custom private-use restriction is not applied to these upstream originals,
their derived data or the unchanged upstream license text. The source map
does not claim that a whole future server/image has one uniform license or
that all combination questions are settled merely by packaging.

## Frontend and build tools

The inspected deployed frontend manifest identifies 131 local Studio frontend
inputs. No npm package source appears in that manifest. esbuild and TypeScript
are build dependencies; no installed npm or Python build-tool binaries are
part of this Git delivery list. Their dependency declarations remain in the
lockfiles. A later distribution that includes those tools or library binaries
needs notices for the actual included artifacts.

## Scope and open decisions

The file-specific map covers the declared, currently available product
sources. Five historically held native unit sources are excluded and missing
from the complete candidate. The unchanged protected legacy component and
root MIT notice are separately retained by the delivery inventory.

Before source publication, close the five exact source reviews, the file
rights/notice decisions, the full candidate suite and the final exact delivery
manifest. The manual testserver does not replace these source checks and is
scheduled after source delivery.

Engine binaries, a complete container image, plugins, runtime libraries and
their corresponding-source/SBOM obligations are a separate future
distribution scope. This source-only review does not clear them.

Primary license references:

- https://opensource.org/license/mit
- https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/blob/42d319c6692fa8e64790fddf0cdaafd2a4254bcc/LICENSE
- https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/blob/42d319c6692fa8e64790fddf0cdaafd2a4254bcc/README.md
